maddeler.e:
استكشفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْشَفُوا (istakšafū) /is.tak.ʃa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# اُسْتُكْشِفُوا (ustukšifū) /us.tuk.ʃi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# اِسْتَكْشِفُوا (istakšifū) /is.tak.ʃi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
